blocking_findings.code: emit() catches only OSError around JSON/write; ValueError or another ordinary diagnostic writer failure escapes
blocking_findings.finding: diagnostic stderr failure changes stock worker behavior
blocking_findings.impact: The first diagnostic can kill the generation worker before the intended policy/preload and later diagnostics can replace stock outcomes, contradicting the stated non-interference and failure/lifecycle-preservation contract.
blocking_findings.required_fix: Contain ordinary exceptions across the whole diagnostic observation/serialization/write path and add regressions with closed/failing stderr that prove stock success remains successful and original preload failure remains authoritative.
